findings.rationale: reproduced on the returned snapshot (0.3/0.1 dropped, station ml -0.98297 instead of -0.74441). Tie handling is not the hard thing; making the reference decide decimal ties exactly would force every solver into decimal arithmetic and invite the mirror Sound Verifier finding. NPM-4 1.2 now keeps every amplitude more than one part in a thousand from three times its noise, so binary and exact arithmetic agree on every legal bulletin; ties left the corpus and the verifier checks the margin at load.

gate.not_mechanizable: recorded as a seal-time check (seal.py numeric_discipline in exact decimals) for this task; the general class 'a float comparison at a discontinuity of the contract' needs a per-task margin argument

findings.rationale: expectations are stored to 9 decimals and the comparator allows 1e-9 on top of 1e-6 for the stored values' rounding, which a 50-digit recomputation puts below 5.1e-10; no output within 1e-6 of the exact figure can be rejected. (Full double precision would push tests/ past the panel's 150 KB read budget.)
